_comment: Torrente water style. Override by shipping assets/torrente/styles/<name>.json in a resource pack. Colours are #RRGGBB; missing keys keep Torrente's fallback. 'Unbound (RatPack)': a from-scratch look-alike of the RatPack Complementary Unbound settings (clear blue, blue x1.10, refraction 1.4, sky-only reflection, cell caustics). No Complementary code.
